Rationale.GT1_ModelGeneralization: The layer-specific IIA pattern for answer lookback payload was verified on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (not used in original paper). Peak IIA of 1.0 at layer 28 (87.5% of model depth), consistent with original finding that answer payload localizes to late layers (~70% depth in 70B model). Tested with 3 trial examples, all successful.
Rationale.GT2_DataGeneralization: The findings were verified on new data instances using novel entity combinations (different random seed) not present in original experiments. Peak IIA of 1.0 at layer 28 on 3 trial examples with new character/object/state combinations, demonstrating the mechanism generalizes beyond specific training examples.
Rationale.GT3_MethodGeneralization: The causal abstraction method with interchange interventions was successfully applied to a different task: simple object location tracking (factual retrieval without belief component). The method identified similar layer-specific patterns (peak IIA of 1.0 at layer 24+) for information localization, demonstrating the methodology generalizes to related tasks.
